text: Oral medicine is a medical discipline that studies the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of oral and maxillofacial diseases, and it has the attributes of both clinical medicine and preventive medicine. The course aims to cultivate students' mastery of the basic theories of stomatology, clinical skills and doctor-patient communication abilities, and to enable them to become dentists with independent diagnosis and treatment capabilities, competent in the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of common and frequently-occurring oral diseases
